items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: I took one lesson on the bass from old man Shala

ctx.x: That after you left Jack Caring?

Oh yeah, Jack was dead then. Yeah, that was in the late years. That was around in the thirties. Around in the thirties, yeah. And, um... After, after we... made up our own little band, well, we wasn't getting much work because we wasn't known at that time, but I still was working with other bands. Now, my first brass band that I would say that I was really a member, you see, because I had started learning trumpet then, but I was taking lessons on the Lewis Demand, I was trying to get away from the reed.
